title: Transitivity of machine reachability
statement: For any multi-tape Turing machine on a fixed input and configurations $a,b,d$, if $b$ is reachable from $a$ and $d$ is reachable from $b$, then $d$ is reachable from $a$.
replaced:
Reachability between configurations of a multi-tape machine on a fixed input is
transitive: if $b$ is reachable from $a$ and $d$ is reachable from $b$, then $d$ is
reachable from $a$.
